The architecture argument stays in docs/js-target-sketch.md; ir-spec wins where they disagree.  Read plan then sketch; do not re-derive.

Headlines from the sketch still stand: front-end reused as-is; translator small (closed p-* vocabulary); BOXES SURVIVE; the CL symbol pain (:invert, pipe-quoting, in-package) vanishes; hard problems = regex and string-eval architecture (Node: pl2cl --server subprocess; browser: product decision).  pclxs: same vtable/ABI, tools/pcl-conform is the acceptance bar.

FIRST SPIKE IF EVER TAKEN = plan II.9 M0 (sketch par.6): S-expr reader + walker for transpile-test-01.t, runtime = boxes + coercion tables, Node-only, no IO/regex/eval.

NOT SCHEDULED.  Do not start without the USER asking.
